text:
On its own, two yellow leaves usually isn't covered. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks after delivery is normal transplant stress. The guarantee (30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members) applies when a plant dies or declines significantly, meaning it loses more than a third of its leaves, gets stem or root rot, or collapses.

If the plant gets worse, you can submit a claim from "My Orders" within your window with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within 2 business days. In the meantime, keep it out of direct sun and only water when the top inch of soil is dry, since overwatering is the most common cause. A Plant Care Specialist can also give you free care advice by chat or email.

If the yellowing is happening after the first two weeks, or you'd like me to escalate, let me know when the plant was delivered and I can help from there.
